texts: itertools.groupby returns consecutive keys and groups from the iterable, so it groups consecutive runs, not equal keys anywhere in the input.
groupby generates a break or new group every time the value of the key function changes.
This behavior differs from SQL GROUP BY, which aggregates common elements regardless of their input order.
To collect all equal keys together, the iterable generally needs to already be sorted on the same key function.
